sunoData.title: Lantern Rest
sunoData.tags: Ambient game music with slow evolving pads, soft felt-piano motifs, breathy synth swells, and a lazy 70 BPM pulse that gently hints at motion; verse-like sections shift from sparse piano and room tone to wider harmonics, a pre-chorus-like lift adds bell arps and filtered shimmer, then the main loop settles into warm sustained chords for safe hubs and reflective travel. Occasional reversed swells, glassy chimes, and subtle sidechain breathing create motion. Intimate, polished, and emotionally unthreatening with a clean cinematic mix., gentle, ambient, slow
